---

### 🚢 Mundra Port — India's Largest Commercial Port

**Location:**
Mundra Port is the largest commercial and container port in India, located on the northern shores of the Gulf of Kutch near Mundra, Kutch district, Gujarat.

**Ownership & Operation:**
It is India's first private port, formerly operated by Mundra Port and Special Economic Zone Limited (MPSEZ) under the ownership of the Adani Group. It was later expanded to become Adani Ports & SEZ Limited (APSEZ), managing several port projects.

**Cargo & Capacity:**
The port currently handles over 155 MT of cargo — the highest in India, constituting nearly 11% of India's total annual maritime cargo. It also handles nearly 33% of India's container traffic.

The port has been designed to handle all types of cargo, including containers, dry bulk, break bulk, liquid cargo, and automobiles. Mundra Port has a capacity to handle 338 MMT of cargo per annum — the largest amongst all operational ports in India.

**Special Economic Zone (SEZ):**
The Port of Mundra is a private port and is also a special economic zone.

**Connectivity:**
The Mundra Port is located in the Northern Gulf of Kutch, en route major maritime routes and connected through rail, road, air, and pipelines.

Mundra Port in Gujarat offers direct connectivity to major global markets including the US East Coast, Europe, Middle East, and Africa. It is linked to the national rail and highway networks, efficiently serving North and Northwest India's industrial and agricultural regions. Regular shipping routes connect Mundra to ports such as Houston, Norfolk, Jebel Ali, and Port Tangier, making it a key logistics hub for international trade.

**Container Terminals:**
Mundra Port operates five container terminals with a total of 12 berths and an annual handling capacity of approximately 8 million TEUs.

**Global Ranking:**
Mundra Port ranks among the top 30 busiest container ports globally.

**Shipping Lines Served:**
The port is served by all major global shipping lines, including Maersk, MSC, CMA CGM, Hapag-Lloyd, COSCO, and Evergreen.

---

In summary, Mundra is a **major deep-water, all-weather private commercial port** in Gujarat, India, serving as a critical gateway for India's international trade.
